verdict.rationale: The SDK side is well evidenced: the docs list API clients, a Checkout SDK, and an open-source design system for native-feeling control-panel apps. They also document app-level OAuth credentials and partner sandboxes, and say developers can create single-click apps for the BigCommerce marketplace, which has 1,200+ apps. However, the evidence shows no app scaffolding tooling and no documented app review or approval process, only the existence of a marketplace. Missing for 10: app scaffolding/starter tooling, documented marketplace review and approval workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of the app development path.
